entities.summary: Salomon Savery was a performers & entertainers in Amsterdam (1594, Amsterdam – 1683) who made significant contributions during the Early Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
